tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: GST registration certificate GST R-3B certificates from April 2026 to SEP 2026 should be uploaded.
List of Items quoted in this tender should be uploaded by mentioning the manufacturer company name of the product, Pack size etc. On the tenderers letter head.

Manufacturer Authorization Form from Principal Manufacturer for the relevant items as per section VII, Annexure I with Drug license copy of manufacturer. In the authorization form name of the products should be mentioned.

Self declaration stating that the firm is not black listed with any Government or sem Government Organizations and will not supply refurbished items to be furnished on a stamp paper of Rs.100 as per proforma section XI Uploaded document must be attested by notary
Valid Drug License of the Bidder should be uploaded.
Valid Form C Shop and Established License
Valid GMP or WHO or FDA or any relevant Certificates of the manufacturer should be uploaded.
Valid ISO Certificate of the bidder issued by a certification body accredited by NABCB National Accreditation Board for Certification Bodies
